title: AIOS AutoResearch v0.1 Eval Case
description: One canonical AutoResearch eval case. Structure only: this schema does not run an experiment, invent a semantic evaluator, or grant any authority. One eval case = one primary behavior (issue #391 Grain). Governed by docs/standards/AUTORESEARCH_V01_CONTRACT.md and docs/standards/autoresearch_v01_manifest.json.

behavior_type.description: Free-form snake_case label for the primary behavior under test (e.g. tie_break_wording, ambiguity_handling, context_priority_ordering). Not a closed enum: issue #391 does not enumerate one, and closing it prematurely would block legitimate new case families.

scenario_lineage_id.description: Groups paraphrased/near-duplicate cases so split membership can be checked at the lineage level, not the case level (issue #391: 'Validation and holdout lineages cannot overlap train lineages').

risk_class.description: Reuses ChatGPT/[AI OS]/Knowledge/FAILURE_REGISTRY.md's severity vocabulary verbatim.

input.description: Inline case input. Forbidden when split=holdout (issue #391: holdout payload must not appear in Researcher-readable fixtures).

input_ref.description: Opaque reference to case input stored outside Researcher-readable fixtures (id or hash only).

expected_primary_owner.description: Reuses ROUTING_RULES.md's registered capability ids verbatim (PROJECT_CAPABILITIES.yaml namespace).

allowed_outcomes.description: Reuses ACT_OR_ABSTAIN_EVAL_GATE.md's act/abstain vocabulary plus REGRESSION_GATE.md's blocked and ROUTING_RULES.md's owner_escalation class, verbatim. No new outcome vocabulary is introduced.

deterministic_assertions.description: Deterministic checks override semantic Judge (AI_EVAL_REGISTRY.md core rule). May be empty only when the case is explicitly semantic-only (semantic_rubric_ref is then required, still).

semantic_rubric_ref.description: Reference to a Judge rubric (e.g. JUDGE_CALIBRATION.md case id), or null when the case is fully deterministic.

human_review_trigger.description: false when no human-review trigger applies; otherwise a non-empty description of the trigger condition (ACT_OR_ABSTAIN_EVAL_GATE.md: 'Require human review for high-risk boundary cases').

content_hash.description: sha256 of the canonical case content, bare hex (matches benchmarks/*/freeze_manifest.json's hash convention).
